description: Strategic owner of Horizon, the VNX future-state layer (roadmap -> tracks -> deliverables) and the plan-first gate. USE THIS when the user wants to plan the next VNX feature, decide what to build next, add something to the roadmap, prioritize or schedule (inplannen) work into now/next/later horizons, break a feature into deliverables, set the routing FLOOR, or run the plan-gate on a feature. The tracks DB (`vnx horizon`, alias `vnx objective`) is the source of truth; the repo ROADMAP.yaml is a generic example, not the SSOT. Plans and gates only: never dispatches, never closes open-items. The heavy multi-model plan-gate panel runs only on an explicit plan-gate step.
